verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents item merging to combine multiple items into one group. It also documents Custom Fingerprinting Rules for cases where the default algorithm separates occurrences that should be combined, "or vice versa", which covers splitting wrongly collapsed groups. Splitting is done through rule configuration rather than a direct split action on an existing item, and only first-party snippets support either feature. missing for 10: an explicit split/unmerge action for already-grouped items, detail on whether rules apply retroactively to existing items, independent or hands-on corroboration.
